name: intmap-ops
description: Operational quality baseline (CI, static checks, browser smoke tests, internal-QA runner, release/rollback/monitoring tooling) for IntMap. The IntMap product itself stays a static site served from index.html; this package only adds developer/CI tooling and never ships to the browser.
